Transaction agreement fixture excerpt. This local test fixture represents an authoritative signed agreement or regulatory filing excerpt; it is not a user narrative note and is not model memory.

The transaction agreement dated 2026-01-15 describes AcquirerCo's acquisition evaluation of TargetCo. The agreement identifies TargetCo as the acquired company and AcquirerCo as the buyer. The transaction economics include $42 million base initial consideration and up to $18 million contingent consideration tied to product and commercial milestones. Payment mechanics require milestone notices, buyer confirmation, and downstream certification before any analysis treats the amounts as final value transfer.
